scope: Synthetic, disposable PostgreSQL scenario with operations reviewer, assigned qualified team lead, receiving Supervisor, direct-report Technician, real VMMS API and browser work-plan/assigned-task UI.

supervisor-handoff form and workspace navigation pass native 400% zoom, name, clipping, target, focus and reachability checks
Stale plan save explains the conflict, keeps entries and succeeds after the current version loads
Retry reuses the original idempotency key and body; committed revision and work-order version remain unchanged
Reloading the real work-order page restores the saved rationale and reordered task sequence
Assigned Technician records a task progress update through the page and reads it back from the scoped API
Assigned Technician can start, recover and stop a server-timed task session without changing task state
Task time controls start and stop by keyboard, announce stale errors, pass automated WCAG checks and fit phone, foldable, tablet and desktop widths
Task upload recovers after its response is lost and rejects another staff member, stale assignment, wrong site and pending scan without partial work
Assigned Technician uploads and scans evidence after handoff without changing work-order scope
Assigned Technician records a work entry and appends a reasoned correction without rewriting the original
Complete 101-entry workshop service report waits for all pages and prints attributed entries and accepted evidence labels as selectable text without application chrome

Supervisor, assigned Team Lead and Head see the properly scoped task progress feed without sign-off controls
Team-lead and supervisor work-queue controls remain usable at phone, foldable, tablet, and desktop viewports without page overflow
Qualified assigned lead saves a versioned ordered draft through the browser and the API returns the same persisted order
Team lead hands the exact current plan revision to a qualified supervisor; API detail binds the handoff to that plan
Operations, assigned team-lead and supervisor queues filter persisted work by current workflow assignments in the API and browser UI

An unassigned same-site Team Lead cannot open the task-progress report directly
Work-plan panel and submit controls fit 11 phone, foldable, tablet, desktop and landscape viewports without horizontal overflow

limitations: Physical-device, production role schedule, SOP and management approval remain untested.
